output.reason: The release note says the feature is promoted to GA and the additional formats are now always enabled [ev-bc29bf53aa1b]. The linked PR says the gate has been "enabled by default for a long time" and now does nothing, but it was kept so that setting it does not break anything [ev-58ea72c4709d][ev-f403c5e69e37]. That means environments that leave the gate unset or enabled see no change. Only environments that explicitly disabled the gate will now get additional formats they had turned off, which is exactly what feature-gate{AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats, disabled} describes.
